ProtoSession.description: One transport-protocol session slot (36 bytes) of the J1939 TP table; the state byte drives vcu_can_tp_sender_tick. Offsets after +0x08 are inferred from the sender code (probably).

fields.name: state
fields.description: Session state: 1 bound and idle, 3 build and send RTS, 4 wait for CTS timeout (1250 ticks), 5 send data, 6 wait for CTS, 9 wait for end-of-message ACK (probably).

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: Pointer to the 300-byte payload buffer bound by proto_session_bind_buffer.

fields.name: capacity
fields.description: Buffer capacity in bytes (300 in this build).

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Bytes already sent or received; advances by 7 for each TP.DT frame (probably).

fields.name: total_size
fields.description: Total message size in bytes (probably); the sender ends with EOM when the offset reaches it.

fields.name: window_end
fields.description: End of the current CTS window in bytes (probably); the sender waits for CTS when the offset reaches it.

fields.name: fragment_size
fields.description: Fragment size set by proto_session_bind_buffer; it is used as a divisor, so it must be nonzero.

fields.name: tick_count
fields.description: Ticks counted towards the inter-packet interval (probably).

fields.name: interval
fields.description: Inter-packet interval in ticks (probably); zero sends several packets in one call.

fields.name: param5
fields.description: Extra argument (param_5) of proto_session_bind_buffer, stored as given; meaning not resolved.
